build_ManifoldFMLitModule: build a PyTorch Lightning module for Riemannian flow matching on manifolds using a tMLP vector field model
run_rfm_loss_fn: run the Riemannian flow matching loss function that computes vector field matching on geodesic paths between base and target points
run_compute_exact_loglikelihood: run exact log-likelihood computation by solving the reverse ODE and accumulating divergence via the change of variables formula
run_sample: run sampling from the learned distribution by integrating the vector field ODE from a random base point to t=1
run_output_and_div: run computation of a vector field output and its divergence using exact Jacobian trace or Rademacher estimator
